newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end subdued trade firmer ahead of key events.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end subdued trade firmer ahead of key events.

text.p: *Key June 10-year JGBs ended firmer near halfway point between Thursday's Tokyo low and LIFFE high. Trade subdued, mainly position adjustments before key events next week, including fiscal year-end, BOJ tankan survey and NCB restructuring.
*Japan industrial output data had neutral impact on JGBs.
